# KuralHub

> KuralHub is a comprehensive survey and benchmark of Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) datasets across the world's languages. It catalogs 90+ SER datasets spanning 70+ languages and benchmarks 11 pretrained speech models (HuBERT, wav2vec 2.0, WavLM, Whisper) on 29 languages across 363 fine-tuning experiments. Maintained by the aaivu lab, University of Moratuwa, Sri Lanka. To appear at Interspeech 2026.

KuralHub helps researchers and practitioners (1) find speech emotion / emotion-speech datasets for a given language, and (2) see which speech model performs best per language.

## Key facts
- Languages surveyed: 70+
- Datasets cataloged: 90+
- Languages benchmarked: 29
- Speech models benchmarked: 11 (hubert-base-ls960, hubert-large-ls960-ft, wav2vec2-base, wav2vec2-large-960h, wav2vec2-large-lv60, wav2vec2-xls-r-1b, wav2vec2-xls-r-300m, wavlm-base-plus, wavlm-large, whisper-large, whisper-small)
- Fine-tuning experiments: 363
- Protocol: each pretrained speech encoder is fine-tuned per language (monolingual) with a classification head on a frozen backbone; validation and test accuracy reported.

## Pages
- [Home / overview](https://aaivu.github.io/KuralHub/): project summary, methodology, key findings, team, citation.
- [Benchmark](https://aaivu.github.io/KuralHub/benchmark.html): validation/test accuracy for every model on every benchmarked dataset; best model per language.
- [Datasets catalog](https://aaivu.github.io/KuralHub/datasets.html): all 70+ languages with dataset metadata and access links.

## Machine-readable data
- Benchmark results (JSON): https://aaivu.github.io/KuralHub/data/benchmark.json
- Language manifest (JSON): https://aaivu.github.io/KuralHub/data/languages.json
- Language families (JSON): https://aaivu.github.io/KuralHub/data/language_families.json

## Citation
Thavarasa, L., Thevakumar, J., Sivatheepan, T., Thayasivam, U. "KuralHub: A Comprehensive Review of Speech Emotion Recognition Datasets." To appear, Interspeech 2026.

## Repository
https://github.com/aaivu/KuralHub

## Best model per benchmarked language
- Afrikaans: best model whisper-small on AfrikaansEmotionalSpeechCorpus — 71.0% test accuracy
- Amharic: best model whisper-small on ASED — 90.0% test accuracy
- Arabic: best model whisper-large on ANAD — 82.0% test accuracy
- Bengali: best model whisper-large on SUBESCO — 89.0% test accuracy
- Chinese: best model whisper-large on ESD — 98.0% test accuracy
- English: best model hubert-base-ls960 on IESC — 82.0% test accuracy
- French: best model wavlm-large on CaFE — 70.0% test accuracy
- German: best model whisper-large on EmoDB — 86.0% test accuracy
- Greek: best model hubert-base-ls960 on AESDD — 75.0% test accuracy
- Hindi: best model whisper-small on Hindi-Dataset — 71.0% test accuracy
- Hungarian: best model hubert-base-ls960 on HungarianEmotionalSpeechCorpus — 52.0% test accuracy
- Indonesian: best model hubert-base-ls960 on IndoWaveSentiment — 99.0% test accuracy
- Italian: best model whisper-large on Emozionalmente — 80.0% test accuracy
- Japanese: best model whisper-large on JVNV — 87.0% test accuracy
- Kannada: best model wavlm-large on Kannada-Dataset — 48.0% test accuracy
- Kazakh: best model whisper-large on KazakhEmotionalTTS — 65.0% test accuracy
- Korean: best model whisper-small on KESDy18 — 81.0% test accuracy
- Odia: best model wavlm-large on SITB-OSED — 83.0% test accuracy
- Persian: best model whisper-small on SHEMO — 83.0% test accuracy
- Polish: best model whisper-large on nEMO — 87.0% test accuracy
- Portuguese: best model whisper-small on emoUERJ — 91.0% test accuracy
- Quechua: best model whisper-large on Quechua-Collao-Corpus — 83.0% test accuracy
- Russian: best model hubert-base-ls960 on RESD — 51.0% test accuracy
- Spanish: best model whisper-small on MESD — 68.0% test accuracy
- Swahili: best model wavlm-base-plus on Swahili-Dataset — 83.0% test accuracy
- Tamil: best model whisper-small on EmoTa — 44.0% test accuracy
- Telugu: best model hubert-base-ls960 on Telugu-Dataset — 53.0% test accuracy
- Turkish: best model whisper-large on TurEV-DB — 84.0% test accuracy
- Urdu: best model wav2vec2-base on Urdu-Dataset — 88.0% test accuracy
